name: FiresOut!
description:
About This Game

FiresOut! is a chaotic co-op game you can play online or from your sofa with up to 4 players, where teamwork can work wonders ... or cause disasters! Play as animal firefighting interns who definitely did not sign up to extinguish fires with a toilet fish, but here you are, bracing yourself and saving civilians in hazardous and complex levels

TEAMWORK MAKES THE FISH WORK

Team up to aim Mr. Glug Glug, a goldfish living in a toilet who blasts water like a fire hose. Make sure to manage the recoils so hang on to your (toilet) seat!

SQUEEZE THE DAY

Navigate tight corridors, winding stairs, falling debris and the occasional meteorites while hauling your tools across burning chaos. With spaces this cramped, you'll need teamwork, timing and maybe a little friendly shoving to squeeze through in one piece.

GRAB 'N' GO

Scoop up fire victims and haul them to safety. Just don't forget to douse them first!  

Features 

  • Fight fires solo or up to 4 players as firefighting interns. Support both local couch or online chaos.

  • Toilet gold fish as your fire extinguisher (his name's Mr Glug Glug).

  • Carry victims or yeet them. They're covered by insurance, anyway.

  • Drive your fire truck between 5 wacky worlds with unique game mechanics.

  • Meteorites, exploding fireballs. Wait... we shouldn't send interns for this.
short_desc: FiresOut! is a chaotic co-op firefighting game for 1 to 4 players. As new interns of the Super Hazard Intervention Taskforce (SHIT), you and your friends must fight fires & rescue victims with only the tool that your captain gave; a toilet goldfish that shoots water. Is your internship cooked?
